proposals.title: Require composition and within-type ablations before conditional generation
proposals.claim: A factorial baseline evaluation can distinguish an apparent mmd_u gain caused by mixture proportions from a gain caused by within-type expression changes, before selecting a conditional generator.
proposals.mechanism: Hold preprocessing, sample size and scorer fixed; compare last-stage resampling, training-estimated composition reweighting, within-type expression shifts, and their combination. Measure mmd_u and de_score plus conditional expression diagnostics; improve attribution, not assert a score gain.
proposals.falsifier: On permitted held-out embryos, cross composition-only and state-only edits. Kill the attribution claim if annotation instability or sampling variability prevents distinguishing these interventions. No biological test can run until data and scorer exist.

evidence.says: Requires strong baselines before VAE, diffusion and related generative experiments; asks whether complexity improves biological metrics.
Defines stage proxies and evaluates contiguous slices of at most 150 cells through an imported scoring module.

evidence.ref: Lopez et al., Deep generative modeling for single-cell transcriptomics, Nature Methods 2018, doi:10.1038/s41592-018-0229-2; https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-018-0229-2
evidence.says: Probabilistic expression modelling explicitly accounts for technical nuisance; it does not establish developmental extrapolation here.

peer_responses.on: diffusion-r1-1 matched benchmark distinguishes flow value from composition-aware simple models
peer_responses.because: Add covariance-preserving within-type residual resampling; mean-only trends are weak comparators. Audit likelihood/support, coupling sensitivity and feasible temporal splits before flow escalation (Neurl IPS 2026/prompts.md:788-843).

peer_responses.on: diffusion-r1-2 missing stationarity evidence does not substantiate blanket transport falsification
peer_responses.because: The persona cites absent experiments; source assertions establish neither tested failure nor success (Neurl IPS 2026/orchestration/personas.py:239-248). Retain unverified status and require method-specific tests.

declined: Latent diffusion as the first model: observation likelihood, unseen-population support and baseline attribution are unresolved. Historical stationarity failures are absent evidence, so I neither certify them nor claim transport has been falsified here.
